  * 序列化收在 controller 层（用户裁决：domain/application 不引入 play-json）。 */
@Singleton
class AggregateStateApiController @Inject() (
    api: Endpoint,
    fundQuotaRepository: FundQuotaRepository,
    fundOrderRepository: FundOrderRepository,
    creditBalanceRepository: CreditBalanceRepository,
    val cc: ControllerComponents)(implicit ec: ExecutionContext) extends BaseController {

  override def controllerComponents: ControllerComponents = cc
  private implicit val timeout: akka.util.Timeout = akka.util.Timeout(5.seconds)

  /** S1 聚合面：State → JSON（逐字段手写·无字段数上限） */
  private implicit val writesState: OWrites[State] =
    (st: State) => Json.obj(
      "minPurchase" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.minPurchase),
      "maxSingleLimit" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.maxSingleLimit),
      "fundTotalUsed" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.fundTotalUsed),
      "fundTotalCap" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.fundTotalCap),
      "perAccountCap" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.perAccountCap))

  /** S1 聚合面：State → JSON（逐字段手写·无字段数上限） */
  private implicit val writesState: OWrites[State] =
    (st: State) => Json.obj(
      "netAmount" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.netAmount),
      "paymentOutcome" -> Json.toJson[String](st.paymentOutcome),
      "taStatus" -> Json.toJson[String](st.taStatus))

  /** S1 聚合面：State → JSON（逐字段手写·无字段数上限） */
  private implicit val writesState: OWrites[State] =
    (st: State) => Json.obj(
      "availableAmount" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.availableAmount),
      "reservedTotal" -> Json.toJson[BigDecimal](st.reservedTotal))

  /** S1 聚合面：GetFundQuotaStateReply 信封（state 字段平铺）——implicit 供 DSL apply[T] 隐参取用 */
  private implicit val writesGetFundQuotaStateReply: OWrites[GetFundQuotaStateReply] =
    (r: GetFundQuotaStateReply) =>
      (writesState: OWrites[State]).writes(r.state)

  /** S1 聚合面：GetFundOrderStateReply 信封（state 字段平铺）——implicit 供 DSL apply[T] 隐参取用 */
  private implicit val writesGetFundOrderStateReply: OWrites[GetFundOrderStateReply] =
    (r: GetFundOrderStateReply) =>

  /** S1 聚合面：GetCreditBalanceStateReply 信封（state 字段平铺）——implicit 供 DSL apply[T] 隐参取用 */
  private implicit val writesGetCreditBalanceStateReply: OWrites[GetCreditBalanceStateReply] =
    (r: GetCreditBalanceStateReply) =>
      (writesState: OWrites[State]).writes(r.state)

  /** S1 聚合面：fund-quota 写侧状态强一致查询（Get<X>State → Reply·不产事件） */
  def fundQuota(id: String): Action[AnyContent] =
    api.global.read().apply[GetFundQuotaStateReply] {
      _ => {
        IdGuard.parse("fundQuotaId" -> id) match {
          case Right(Seq(fundQuotaIdCid)) =>
            fundQuotaRepository.entityRef(id).ask {
              (replyTo: akka.actor.typed.ActorRef[GetFundQuotaStateReply]) =>
                GetFundQuotaState(fundQuotaIdCid, replyTo)
            }.map(reply => Right(reply): Either[ApiError, GetFundQuotaStateReply])
          case Left(err) =>
            scala.concurrent.Future.successful(Left(err): Either[ApiError, GetFundQuotaStateReply])
        }
      }
    }

  def fundOrder(id: String): Action[AnyContent] =
    api.global.read().apply[GetFundOrderStateReply] {
      _ => {
        IdGuard.parse("fundOrderId" -> id) match {
          case Right(Seq(fundOrderIdCid)) =>
            fundOrderRepository.entityRef(id).ask {
              (replyTo: akka.actor.typed.ActorRef[GetFundOrderStateReply]) =>

          case Left(err) =>

        }
      }
    }

  def creditBalance(id: String): Action[AnyContent] =

        IdGuard.parse("creditBalanceId" -> id) match {

            }.map(reply => Right(reply): Either[ApiError, GetCreditBalanceStateReply])
          case Left(err) =>
            scala.concurrent.Future.successful(
              Left(err): Either[ApiError, GetCreditBalanceStateReply])
        }
      }
    }
